h1: Narasiri Service Apartment Prachinburi — A Budget In-Town Stay Near the Market with Free Parking
intro: If you're in Prachinburi on errands, or you just want a cheap nightly room that's easy to drive to and close to the market — Narasiri Service Apartment is a name budget travellers keep running into. It's a 2-star service apartment on Prachinthakarn Road Soi 6 in Na Muang subdistrict, in the town centre about 600 m from the middle of town. The draw is the in-town location near the night market and restaurants, plus free parking and a 24-hour front desk. Rates start at about ฿390/night, rising to around ฿450–550 for a queen room or on weekends.

body.html: The heart of Narasiri Service Apartment is its town-centre location in Prachinburi at a few hundred baht a night. The property sits on Prachinthakarn Road Soi 6 in Na Muang subdistrict, about 600 m from the middle of town and close to the Prachinburi night market — an easy walk or short drive for an evening meal. There are convenience stores and several restaurants nearby, while Wat Kaeo Phichit and Chao Phraya Abhaibhubejhr Hospital are about a 5-minute drive away. It suits anyone in town on errands, on official business, or stopping over for a night, far more conveniently than a hillside resort you'd have to drive out to.

The property is a simple service apartment with 24 rooms, split between Standard Twin (two single beds) and Standard Queen (one large bed). Each room has air conditioning, a fridge, cable TV, a desk and an en-suite bathroom with a hot shower and free bottled water. What real reviews mention is that the rooms are clean enough and good value for the price, fine for a one-night stay. It's a place built around simplicity and location rather than design.
"Friendly owner who greets you warmly, the room was clean enough, it's near the market and the price is low — good value for a one-night stop in town."

On the facilities side, things are about right for this level. There's free parking, a 24-hour front desk, a snack bar and a small lobby bar, plus daily housekeeping. Wi-Fi is free in the common areas. The thing to know is that there's no breakfast and no swimming pool, which is normal for a budget in-town stay. In the morning you can walk out to the market or a nearby rice-and-curry shop for something to eat without going far.

The in-town location also helps for getting around. It's about a 5-minute drive to Wat Kaeo Phichit and the Chao Phraya Abhaibhubejhr Hospital and Thai traditional-medicine museum, a Prachinburi landmark. The Prachinburi National Museum and the city shrine are close by too. From here you can drive on toward the Prachinburi side of Khao Yai, the Noen Hom area or Kabin Buri. If you're using this as a one-night base before moving on, it slots neatly into a low budget.

To be honest about what to expect before booking: this is a 2-star budget property, not a smart hotel. Some reviews say the beds are quite firm and not the most comfortable to sleep on, and that the bathroom fixtures and the wooden flooring are showing their age, with the odd creak. The styling is plain and basic for the price, with nothing flashy about it. If you're expecting luxury or a natural setting, this isn't it — but as a few-hundred-baht stay in the centre of town, it delivers location and convenience that are good enough.

Overall, Narasiri Service Apartment scores 6.3 out of 10 from 5 reviews on Trip.com — still a small sample. The points that get praised are the easygoing owner and being close to the market. Rates start around ฿390 for a standard room, rising to about ฿450–550 for a queen room or on weekends. If you want an in-town room that's easy to drive to, near the market and easy to park at, on a low budget, this fits the bill for a one-night stay or for getting things done in town.

A tip from following the reviews here: if you're worried about firm beds, ask about a room with a softer mattress or check when you arrive, and give the room a quick once-over for cleanliness since it's a budget place. If you're there to eat well, drop by the night market in the evening — it's close. If you're arriving late, call ahead on +66 99 198 8285 to arrange key pickup. And book ahead over long weekends, since cheap in-town rooms like this fill up fast.
